This indicates a chain of molecular interactions where 6-Hydroxycoumarin may influence A549 through its interaction with SNU-387 and Gramideoxybenzoin H. The scores from the two paths, while not perfectly aligned, both suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact mechanism remains unclear.
